assignments.name: SetCompanyProfileForMatching
assignments.label: (マッチング用)会社概要を設定

Flow.description: IF(NOT(ISBLANK()))を追加して、値がある場合のみ挿入するように変更。

formulas.name: CompanyProfileForMatching
formulas.expression: IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Description})), {!$Record.Description} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TSRDescription__c})), {!$Record.TSRDescription__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TSRPurpose__c})), {!$Record.TSRPurpose__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record.TDBMiddleClassification__c}))), TEXT({!$Record.TDBMiddleClassification__c}) & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TDBSubCategory__c})), {!$Record.TDBSubCategory__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TDBSubclassification__c})), {!$Record.TDBSubclassification__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TSRIndustry1__c})), {!$Record.TSRIndustry1__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TSRIndustry2__c})), {!$Record.TSRIndustry2__c} & ",", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.TSRIndustry3__c})), {!$Record.TSRIndustry3__c} & ",", "" )
